deviations.what: the original view writes minSize="200px" on the third SplitterLayoutData, but sap.ui.layout.SplitterLayoutData.minSize is typed int - UI5 would parse the px suffix fine (int.parseValue is parseInt); what rejects it is the corpus linter's invalid-property-value rule for a non-numeric literal on a numeric type. The port writes the numeric value 200 the original means.
